criteria.intent: Open-spec devcontainer builds a digest-bound image with exactly the CI Node/Python versions and a verified Node archive.
criteria.automated_scope: CONTAINER checks pins, digest, checksum and open-spec fields from source; the real image build runs in the Development environment workflow.

criteria.intent: One setup/build/check/serve/doctor entry delegating to the existing locked owners.
criteria.automated_scope: CONTAINER verifies the exact delegated plans; execution inside the image is the workflow run.

criteria.intent: CI builds the same Containerfile and runs doctor, setup and check inside it.
criteria.automated_scope: WORKFLOW verifies the workflow shape; only an actual run on the PR head proves it.

criteria.intent: Vendor-neutral AI entry with AGENTS.md as router.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY verifies wording and the guide link; usefulness needs review.

criteria.intent: Browser-only workflow on interchangeable hosts and hosting as a replaceable adapter.
criteria.automated_scope: ENTRY verifies named hosts and adapter owners; the iPad trial is external.

criteria.intent: Registries, RI, layout, format and CS01/CS04/CS05 stay green.
criteria.automated_scope: BASIC, RI-CI and STYLE prove their enforced subsets; architecture judgment needs review.

criteria.intent: AGENTS.md-native, vendor-neutral agent runners: pinned OpenCode and Codex CLI, reviewer roles generated outside the repo from agents/reviewers, cascaded Codex review rules in AGENTS.md, no vendor-specific agent files.
criteria.automated_scope: CONTAINER verifies generation, outside-checkout writes, review argument validation and absence of vendor files; RUNNERS verifies the lock, AGENTS.md rules and guide route. Real sign-in, subagent isolation and Codex PR review need an operator trial.

REVIEW.description: Independent nonauthor review of the exact PR head by every role the scope requires (Requirements & Acceptance, Code, White-box QA, Exploratory QA), launched under agents/reviewers/README.md isolation, with recorded findings and dispositions.

CI-RUN.description: Development environment workflow passes on the exact PR head.

CONTROL.description: Maintainer accepts the new workflow and tools/quality control changes and decides the merge.

DEVICE.description: Maintainer opens the environment on a devcontainer host from the iPad, signs in to OpenCode and Codex inside it, confirms AGENTS.md is the loaded rule file, runs one Codex review of the exact PR head and records its findings and dispositions.

ISOLATION.description: Record one verified OpenCode subagent run showing no parent-conversation inheritance before its reviews count under agents/reviewers/README.md.
